title: Plain Stewed Apples
blurb: Gently cooked apples that break down into a soft, naturally sweet compote. Serve warm or cold with porridge, yoghurt or on their own.
steps: Peel the apples, cut them into quarters and remove the cores. Chop each quarter into rough chunks.
Put the apple pieces and water into a medium saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low.
Cover and cook for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apples have completely softened and started to break down.
Mash lightly with a fork if you want a smoother texture, or leave as chunky pieces. Serve warm or leave to cool.
